source.text: שִׁמְע֣וּ אֶת־הַדָּבָ֗ר אֲשֶׁ֨ר דִּבֶּ֧ר יְהוָ֛ה עֲלֵיכֶ֖ם בֵּ֥ית יִשְׂרָאֵֽל׃

records.literal_gloss: Hear the word which has spoken Yahweh to you, house of Israel.

en.L: Hear the word that {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} has spoken to you, house of Israel.
en.B: Hear the word that {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} has spoken to you, house of Israel.
en.R: People of Israel, listen to the message {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} has for you.

es.L: {{plural_you:Oigan|Oíd}} la palabra que {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}} {{plural_you:les|os}} ha hablado, casa de Israel.
es.B: {{plural_you:Escuchen|Escuchad}} la palabra que {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}} {{plural_you:les|os}} ha dirigido, casa de Israel.
es.R: Pueblo de Israel, {{plural_you:escuchen|escuchad}} el mensaje que {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}} tiene para {{plural_you:ustedes|vosotros}}.

fr.L: Écoutez la parole que {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} vous a adressée, maison d’Israël.
fr.B: Écoutez la parole que {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} vous adresse, maison d’Israël.
fr.R: Peuple d’Israël, écoutez le message que {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} a pour vous.

sw.L: Sikieni neno ambalo {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} amesema nanyi, nyumba ya Israeli.
sw.B: Sikilizeni neno ambalo {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} amewaambia, enyi nyumba ya Israeli.
sw.R: Enyi watu wa Israeli, sikilizeni ujumbe ambao {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} anao kwa ajili yenu.

vi.L: Hãy nghe lời {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} đã phán với các ngươi, hỡi nhà Y-sơ-ra-ên.
vi.B: Hỡi nhà Y-sơ-ra-ên, hãy nghe lời {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} đã phán với các ngươi.
vi.R: Hỡi dân Y-sơ-ra-ên, hãy lắng nghe sứ điệp {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} dành cho các ngươi.

ko.L: 이스라엘 집아, {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께서 너희에게 하신 말씀을 들어라.
ko.B: 이스라엘 집아, {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께서 너희에게 하신 말씀을 들어라.
ko.R: 이스라엘 백성아, {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께서 너희에게 주시는 말씀을 들어라.

pt.L: Ouçam a palavra que {{divine_name:o SENHOR|Javé}} falou a vocês, casa de Israel.
pt.B: Ouçam a palavra que {{divine_name:o SENHOR|Javé}} dirigiu a vocês, casa de Israel.
pt.R: Povo de Israel, escutem a mensagem que {{divine_name:o SENHOR|Javé}} tem para vocês.

decisions.choice: house of Israel: the whole covenant people, here those living in Judah
decisions.reason: The northern kingdom had fallen to Assyria long before (2 Kings 17:6). Jeremiah still calls the people of Judah and Jerusalem by the old name of the whole nation descended from Jacob (2:4; 9:25), the people bound to God by his covenant.

decisions.choice: to you: addressed to you
decisions.reason: The preposition can mean "to" or "concerning"; here it introduces the people the message is spoken to, as the call "hear" shows.

decisions.choice: People of Israel
decisions.reason: Readable says "people of Israel" for "house of Israel", since "house" here means a family line, not a building, and puts the call to listen first, as a plain call to attention.

source.text: כֹּ֣ה׀אָמַ֣ר יְהוָ֗ה אֶל־דֶּ֤רֶךְ הַגּוֹיִם֙ אַל־תִּלְמָ֔דוּ וּמֵאֹת֥וֹת הַשָּׁמַ֖יִם אַל־תֵּחָ֑תּוּ כִּֽי־יֵחַ֥תּוּ הַגּוֹיִ֖ם מֵהֵֽמָּה׃

records.literal_gloss: Thus says Yahweh: to [the] way of the nations do not learn, and at [the] signs of the heavens do not be dismayed, for are dismayed the nations at them.

en.L: Thus says {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}: Do not learn the way of the nations, \q and do not be dismayed at the signs of the heavens, \q for the nations are dismayed at them.
en.B: {{divine_name:The LORD|Yahweh}} says this: Do not take up the ways of the nations, \q and do not be terrified by signs in the sky, \q though the nations are terrified by them.
en.R: This is what {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} says: Do not copy the way the other nations live. \q Do not be afraid of strange signs in the sky. \q Let the other nations be afraid of them.

es.L: Así dice {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}}: No {{plural_you:aprendan|aprendáis}} el camino de las naciones, \q ni {{plural_you:se aterren|os aterréis}} por las señales de los cielos, \q porque las naciones se aterran por ellas.
es.B: {{divine_name:El SEÑOR|Yahvé}} dice esto: No {{plural_you:adopten|adoptéis}} las costumbres de las naciones, \q ni {{plural_you:se espanten|os espantéis}} por las señales del cielo, \q aunque las naciones se espanten por ellas.
es.R: Esto es lo que dice {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}}: No {{plural_you:imiten|imitéis}} la manera de vivir de las otras naciones. \q No {{plural_you:tengan|tengáis}} miedo de las señales extrañas en el cielo. \q Que las otras naciones les tengan miedo.

fr.L: Ainsi parle {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} : N’apprenez pas la voie des nations, \q et ne vous effrayez pas des signes du ciel, \q car les nations s’en effraient.
fr.B: {{divine_name:Le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} dit ceci : N’adoptez pas les coutumes des nations, \q et ne soyez pas terrifiés par les signes dans le ciel, \q même si les nations en sont terrifiées.
fr.R: Voici ce que dit {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} : N’imitez pas la façon de vivre des autres nations. \q N’ayez pas peur des signes étranges dans le ciel. \q Laissez les autres nations en avoir peur.

sw.L: {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} asema hivi: Msijifunze njia ya mataifa, \q wala msifadhaike kwa ishara za mbinguni, \q kwa maana mataifa hufadhaika kwa hizo.
sw.B: Hivi ndivyo {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} asemavyo: Msiige njia za mataifa, \q wala msiogope ishara za angani, \q ingawa mataifa huziogopa.
sw.R: Hili ndilo {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} analosema: Msiige jinsi mataifa mengine yanavyoishi. \q Msiogope ishara za ajabu angani. \q Mataifa mengine na yaziogope.

vi.L: {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} phán thế này: Đừng học theo đường lối của các dân tộc, \q và đừng kinh hãi vì các dấu lạ trên trời, \q vì các dân tộc kinh hãi vì chúng.
vi.B: {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} phán như vầy: Đừng bắt chước lối sống của các dân tộc, \q và đừng khiếp sợ vì các điềm lạ trên trời, \q dù các dân tộc khiếp sợ vì những điềm ấy.
vi.R: Đây là lời {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} phán: Đừng bắt chước cách sống của các dân tộc khác. \q Đừng sợ những điềm lạ trên bầu trời. \q Cứ để các dân tộc khác sợ những điều ấy.

ko.L: {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께서 이와 같이 말씀하신다. 너희는 민족들의 길을 배우지 마라. \q 하늘의 징조들을 보고 놀라지 마라. \q 민족들이 그것들을 보고 놀란다.
ko.B: {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께서 이렇게 말씀하신다. 민족들의 풍습을 따르지 마라. \q 하늘에 나타나는 징조들을 보고 두려워하지 마라. \q 민족들은 그것들을 두려워하지만 너희는 그러지 마라.
ko.R: {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께서 하시는 말씀이다. 다른 민족들이 사는 방식을 흉내 내지 마라. \q 하늘에 나타나는 이상한 징조들을 두려워하지 마라. \q 다른 민족들이나 그것들을 두려워하게 내버려 두어라.

pt.L: Assim diz {{divine_name:o SENHOR|Javé}}: Não aprendam o caminho das nações, \q e não se apavorem com os sinais dos céus, \q pois as nações se apavoram com eles.
pt.B: Assim diz {{divine_name:o SENHOR|Javé}}: Não adotem os costumes das nações, \q e não se deixem abater pelos sinais no céu, \q ainda que as nações se deixem abater por eles.
pt.R: É isto que {{divine_name:o SENHOR|Javé}} diz: Não imitem o jeito de viver das outras nações. \q Não tenham medo de sinais estranhos no céu. \q Deixem que as outras nações tenham medo deles.

decisions.choice: the way of the nations: their customs, above all in worship
decisions.reason: "Way" is a manner of life. The next verse names it as the "customs of the peoples", and the whole poem (verses 3-5, 8-9, 14-15) shows that their worship of idols is meant. Israel is not to learn it (Leviticus 18:3; Deuteronomy 18:9).

decisions.choice: the signs of the heavens: eclipses, comets and other sights in the sky read as omens
decisions.reason: The peoples of Mesopotamia kept long records of what they saw in the sky and read it as warnings about kings and nations. Israel was told not to worship the sun, moon and stars or treat them as powers (Deuteronomy 4:19), since God made them (Genesis 1:14-18).

decisions.choice: be dismayed: be shattered with fear
decisions.reason: The verb means to be broken down by terror (1:17; Isaiah 30:31). The same verb is used of Israel and of the nations, to set the two side by side.

decisions.choice: for: the nations' fear is theirs, not Israel's
decisions.reason: The joining word gives the reason not to be afraid: these signs frighten the nations, who do not know the God who made the heavens (verses 11-12). It can also be read "though" with the same sense.

decisions.choice: though (Balanced); Let the other nations be afraid of them (Readable)
decisions.reason: Balanced says "though" so that the reason reads naturally; Readable turns it into a short statement that the fear belongs to the nations and not to Israel (meaning decision m4). Readable also adds "other" and "strange" to make clear who and what is meant.

source.text: כִּֽי־חֻקּ֥וֹת הָֽעַמִּ֖ים הֶ֣בֶל ה֑וּא כִּֽי־עֵץ֙ מִיַּ֣עַר כְּרָת֔וֹ מַעֲשֵׂ֥ה יְדֵ֥י־חָרָ֖שׁ בַּֽמַּעֲצָֽד׃

records.literal_gloss: For [the] customs of the peoples futility [is] it; for a tree from [the] forest one cuts it, [the] work of [the] hands of a craftsman with the tool.

en.L: For the customs of the peoples [are] futility; \q for a tree from the forest someone cuts down, \q the work of the hands of a craftsman with the tool.
en.B: The customs of the peoples are empty breath: \q a tree is cut down from the forest \q and worked by a craftsman's hands with his tool.
en.R: The way these nations worship is worthless. \q Someone cuts down a tree in the forest, \q and a skilled worker shapes it with his tools.

es.L: Porque las costumbres de los pueblos [son] vanidad; \q porque un árbol del bosque alguien corta, \q obra de manos de artesano con la herramienta.
es.B: Las costumbres de los pueblos son un soplo vacío: \q cortan un árbol del bosque \q y un artesano lo trabaja con sus manos y su herramienta.
es.R: La manera en que adoran esas naciones no vale nada. \q Alguien corta un árbol en el bosque, \q y un artesano le da forma con sus herramientas.

fr.L: Car les coutumes des peuples [sont] vanité ; \q car c’est un arbre qu’on coupe dans la forêt, \q l’ouvrage des mains d’un artisan avec l’outil.
fr.B: Les coutumes des peuples ne sont que vent : \q on coupe un arbre dans la forêt, \q et la main de l’artisan le travaille avec son outil.
fr.R: La façon dont ces nations adorent ne vaut rien. \q Quelqu’un coupe un arbre dans la forêt, \q et un ouvrier habile le façonne avec ses outils.

sw.L: Kwa maana desturi za mataifa [ni] ubatili; \q kwa maana mtu hukata mti msituni, \q kazi ya mikono ya fundi kwa chombo chake.
sw.B: Desturi za mataifa ni pumzi tupu: \q mti hukatwa msituni \q na kuchongwa kwa mikono ya fundi kwa chombo chake.
sw.R: Jinsi mataifa haya yanavyoabudu haifai kitu. \q Mtu hukata mti msituni, \q na fundi stadi huuchonga kwa vyombo vyake.

vi.L: Vì các tục lệ của các dân là hư không; \q vì người ta đốn một cây trong rừng, \q là công việc của tay thợ dùng dụng cụ.
vi.B: Các tục lệ của các dân chỉ là hơi thở hư không: \q người ta đốn một cây trong rừng, \q rồi thợ dùng dụng cụ đẽo gọt bằng tay mình.
vi.R: Cách các dân tộc ấy thờ cúng thật vô giá trị. \q Có người đốn một cây trong rừng, \q rồi một người thợ khéo dùng dụng cụ đẽo nó thành hình.

ko.L: 민족들의 풍습은 헛된 것이다. \q 사람이 숲에서 나무를 베어 오면 \q 그것은 장인이 연장으로 손으로 만든 것이다.
ko.B: 민족들의 풍습은 헛된 입김이다. \q 숲에서 나무를 베어 와서 \q 장인이 손에 연장을 들고 다듬은 것일 뿐이다.
ko.R: 이 민족들이 섬기는 방식은 쓸모없다. \q 누군가가 숲에서 나무를 베어 오면 \q 솜씨 좋은 일꾼이 연장으로 그것을 다듬는다.

pt.L: Pois os costumes dos povos [são] sopro; \q pois uma árvore da floresta alguém corta, \q obra das mãos do artífice com a ferramenta.
pt.B: Os costumes dos povos são um sopro vazio: \q cortam uma árvore da floresta, \q e um artesão a trabalha com as mãos e com a sua ferramenta.
pt.R: O jeito como essas nações adoram não vale nada. \q Alguém corta uma árvore na floresta, \q e um artesão habilidoso dá forma a ela com as suas ferramentas.

decisions.choice: customs: the fixed rites and practices of the peoples' religion
decisions.reason: The word is the one used for God's own statutes. Here it is the set customs of other peoples (Leviticus 18:3, 30; 20:23), and the verse at once describes what they are: making an idol.

decisions.choice: futility: breath, vapor, something with no substance
decisions.reason: The word means a breath of air and so what is empty and passes away. It is a key word in this poem (verses 8 and 15, where it names the idols themselves) and recalls 2:5, where Israel "went after futility and became futile".

decisions.choice: the tool: a cutting tool, perhaps an adze or an axe
decisions.reason: The word appears only here and in Isaiah 44:12. It is an iron tool used to shape wood or metal; its exact form is not known.

decisions.choice: a tree from the forest made into a god
decisions.reason: The picture follows Isaiah's satire of idol making, where a man cuts down a tree, burns half of it and carves a god from the rest (Isaiah 44:9-20; 40:19-20). The point is the same: the god is only what human hands have made from wood.

decisions.choice: empty breath (Balanced); The way these nations worship is worthless (Readable)
decisions.reason: Balanced keeps the picture in "futility" with "empty breath" and leaves the opening "for" unsaid, since the verse begins the reason for verse 2 without needing the word. Readable says plainly which customs are meant (meaning decision m1) and uses "worthless" for the empty breath.

decisions.choice: ubatili (Literal); pumzi tupu (Balanced); haifai kitu (Readable)
decisions.reason: Hevel, "breath, vapor", the word of verses 3, 8 and 15 for the idols; each level keeps its wording in those verses.

decisions.choice: "vanité" (L); "ne sont que vent" (B); "ne vaut rien" (R)
decisions.reason: *Hevel* is "breath, vapour"; Balanced keeps the picture with "vent", as the English says "empty breath".

decisions.choice: "hư không" (Literal); "hơi thở hư không" (Balanced); "vô giá trị" (Readable)
decisions.reason: Hevel is breath or vapor; Balanced keeps the picture, as the English "empty breath" does, and the same wording returns in verses 8 and 15.

decisions.choice: sopro (L); um sopro vazio (B); não vale nada (R)
decisions.reason: For the poem on idols (verses 3, 8, 15) and the book: hevel, a breath (m2), is "sopro" at Literal and Balanced, the word Ecclesiastes 1:2 and the Psalms use in Portuguese, so that the picture of something with no substance is kept; Readable says what it means, as the English Readable does. 2:5 keeps "ídolos inúteis" with the verb, as 2 Kings 17:15 has it.

source.text: בְּכֶ֥סֶף וּבְזָהָ֖ב יְיַפֵּ֑הוּ בְּמַסְמְר֧וֹת וּבְמַקָּב֛וֹת יְחַזְּק֖וּם וְל֥וֹא יָפִֽיק׃

records.literal_gloss: With silver and with gold he beautifies it; with nails and with hammers they fasten them, and not it will totter.

en.L: With silver and with gold he makes it beautiful; \q with nails and with hammers they fasten them, so that it will not totter.
en.B: He decorates it with silver and gold; \q they fix it in place with hammer and nails so that it will not topple over.
en.R: He covers it with silver and gold. \q Then they use hammers and nails to fix it in place so that it will not fall over.

es.L: Con plata y con oro lo embellece; \q con clavos y con martillos los sujetan, para que no se tambalee.
es.B: Lo adorna con plata y oro; \q lo fijan con martillo y clavos para que no se caiga.
es.R: Lo cubre de plata y oro. \q Luego usan martillos y clavos para fijarlo, para que no se caiga.

fr.L: D’argent et d’or il l’embellit ; \q avec des clous et des marteaux on les fixe, pour qu’elle ne vacille pas.
fr.B: On la décore d’argent et d’or ; \q on la fixe avec le marteau et les clous pour qu’elle ne tombe pas.
fr.R: On la recouvre d’argent et d’or. \q Puis on se sert de marteaux et de clous pour la fixer, pour qu’elle ne tombe pas.

sw.L: Huupamba kwa fedha na kwa dhahabu; \q huvikaza kwa misumari na kwa nyundo, ili usitikisike.
sw.B: Huupamba kwa fedha na dhahabu; \q huukaza mahali pake kwa nyundo na misumari ili usianguke.
sw.R: Huufunika kwa fedha na dhahabu. \q Kisha hutumia nyundo na misumari kuukaza mahali pake ili usianguke.

vi.L: Người ta lấy bạc và vàng trang hoàng nó; \q người ta dùng đinh và búa đóng chặt chúng, để nó khỏi lung lay.
vi.B: Người ta trang trí nó bằng bạc và vàng; \q họ lấy búa và đinh đóng cho chắc để nó khỏi ngã.
vi.R: Người ta bọc nó bằng bạc và vàng. \q Rồi họ dùng búa và đinh đóng nó cho chắc để nó khỏi ngã.

ko.L: 그가 은과 금으로 그것을 아름답게 꾸미고, \q 그들이 못과 망치로 그것들을 고정시켜 흔들리지 않게 한다.
ko.B: 그는 은과 금으로 그것을 장식하고, \q 그들은 망치와 못으로 그것을 단단히 박아 넘어지지 않게 한다.
ko.R: 그는 그것을 은과 금으로 입힌다. \q 그러고 나서 그들은 망치와 못으로 그것을 고정시켜 넘어지지 않게 한다.

pt.L: Com prata e com ouro ele a embeleza; \q com pregos e com martelos eles os fixam, para que não oscile.
pt.B: Ele a enfeita com prata e ouro; \q com martelo e pregos a firmam no lugar para que não tombe.
pt.R: Ele a cobre de prata e ouro. \q Depois usam martelos e pregos para prendê-la no lugar, para que não caia.

decisions.choice: with silver and with gold: a wooden image overlaid with precious metal
decisions.reason: Idols were often carved from wood and then covered with thin sheets of silver or gold (verse 9; Isaiah 40:19; 30:22).

decisions.choice: he ... they ... them: the craftsman, then the workers, then the idols in general
decisions.reason: The verse moves from one craftsman to the people who help him, and from one idol to idols in general. The change shows a whole trade at work, not one person.

decisions.choice: fastened with nails so that it will not totter
decisions.reason: Isaiah mocks the same thing: an idol must be fastened with nails so that it does not topple (Isaiah 41:7; 40:20). A god that has to be held up cannot hold anyone else up.

decisions.choice: covers it
decisions.reason: Readable says "covers" for "makes beautiful", since the beauty is the silver and gold laid over the wood (meaning decision m1).

source.text: כְּתֹ֨מֶר מִקְשָׁ֥ה הֵ֨מָּה֙ וְלֹ֣א יְדַבֵּ֔רוּ נָשׂ֥וֹא יִנָּשׂ֖וּא כִּ֣י לֹ֣א יִצְעָ֑דוּ אַל־תִּֽירְא֤וּ מֵהֶם֙ כִּי־לֹ֣א יָרֵ֔עוּ וְגַם־הֵיטֵ֖יב אֵ֥ין אוֹתָֽם׃ס

records.literal_gloss: Like a scarecrow of a cucumber field they [are], and not they speak; surely they are carried, for not they walk. Do not fear them, for not they do harm, and also doing good not [is] in them.

en.L: Like a scarecrow in a cucumber field [are] they, and they do not speak; \q they must surely be carried, for they do not walk. \q Do not be afraid of them, for they cannot do harm, \q and also doing good is not in them.
en.B: Like a scarecrow in a cucumber patch, they cannot speak; \q they have to be carried, for they cannot walk. \q Do not be afraid of them: they can do no harm, \q and they have no power to do good either.
en.R: Idols are like scarecrows in a cucumber field. They cannot talk. \q People have to carry them, because they cannot walk. \q Do not be afraid of them. They cannot hurt you, \q and they cannot help you either.

es.L: Como espantapájaros en un pepinar [son] ellos, y no hablan; \q tienen que ser llevados, porque no andan. \q No {{plural_you:les tengan|les tengáis}} miedo, porque no pueden hacer mal, \q ni tampoco está en ellos hacer bien.
es.B: Como espantapájaros en un huerto de pepinos, no pueden hablar; \q hay que cargarlos, porque no pueden caminar. \q No {{plural_you:les tengan|les tengáis}} miedo: no pueden hacer ningún mal, \q y tampoco tienen poder para hacer el bien.
es.R: Los ídolos son como espantapájaros en un campo de pepinos. No pueden hablar. \q La gente tiene que cargarlos, porque no pueden caminar. \q No {{plural_you:les tengan|les tengáis}} miedo. No pueden {{plural_you:hacerles|haceros}} daño, \q y tampoco pueden {{plural_you:ayudarlos|ayudaros}}.

fr.L: Comme un épouvantail dans un champ de concombres [sont-elles], et elles ne parlent pas ; \q il faut les porter, car elles ne marchent pas. \q N’en ayez pas peur, car elles ne peuvent faire de mal, \q et faire du bien n’est pas non plus en elles.
fr.B: Comme un épouvantail dans un champ de concombres, elles ne parlent pas ; \q il faut les porter, car elles ne marchent pas. \q N’en ayez pas peur : elles ne peuvent pas faire de mal, \q et elles n’ont pas non plus le pouvoir de faire du bien.
fr.R: Les idoles sont comme des épouvantails dans un champ de concombres. Elles ne savent pas parler. \q Il faut les porter, parce qu’elles ne peuvent pas marcher. \q N’ayez pas peur d’elles. Elles ne peuvent pas vous faire de mal, \q et elles ne peuvent pas vous aider non plus.

sw.R: Sanamu ni kama vitisha-ndege katika shamba la matango. Haziwezi kusema. \q Watu wanalazimika kuzibeba, kwa sababu haziwezi kutembea. \q Msiziogope. Haziwezi kuwadhuru, \q wala haziwezi kuwasaidia.

vi.L: Chúng như bù nhìn trong ruộng dưa, và chúng không nói được; \q chúng phải được khiêng đi, vì chúng không đi được. \q Đừng sợ chúng, vì chúng không thể làm hại, \q và cũng chẳng có khả năng làm điều tốt.
vi.B: Như bù nhìn trong ruộng dưa, chúng không nói được; \q chúng phải được khiêng đi, vì chúng không thể bước. \q Đừng sợ chúng: chúng chẳng làm hại được ai, \q và cũng chẳng có quyền làm điều lành.
vi.R: Các thần tượng giống như bù nhìn trong ruộng dưa. Chúng không biết nói. \q Người ta phải khiêng chúng, vì chúng không đi được. \q Đừng sợ chúng. Chúng không làm hại các ngươi được, \q mà cũng không giúp gì các ngươi được.

ko.L: 그것들은 오이밭의 허수아비 같아서 말을 하지 못한다. \q 걷지 못하니 반드시 메고 다녀야 한다. \q 그것들을 두려워하지 마라. 그것들은 해를 끼치지 못하고, \q 선을 행하는 것도 그것들에게는 없다.

pt.L: Como espantalho num campo de pepinos [são] eles, e não falam; \q certamente precisam ser carregados, pois não andam. \q Não tenham medo deles, pois não podem fazer mal, \q e também fazer o bem não está neles.

decisions.choice: a scarecrow in a cucumber field
alternatives: like a palm tree of hammered work
like a post in a cucumber field
decisions.reason: The phrase is rare and its sense is not certain. The first word elsewhere means a palm tree (Judges 4:5), and the second can mean a cucumber field (Isaiah 1:8) or hammered metalwork (Exodus 25:18). Read as a scarecrow, it pictures a stiff figure set up in a field that frightens no one who knows what it is; a later Jewish writing, the Letter of Jeremiah, uses the same picture of idols. Read the other way, it is "like a palm-shaped post of hammered work", an upright pillar that cannot speak.

decisions.choice: they must surely be carried: the verb is doubled for emphasis
decisions.reason: The Hebrew repeats the verb ("carrying, they are carried") to stress it. Isaiah sets the gods that must be carried against the God who carries his people (Isaiah 46:1-7).

decisions.choice: do harm ... do good: do anything at all
decisions.reason: Harm and good together form a pair that covers everything; to say the idols can do neither is to say they can do nothing (Isaiah 41:23; Zephaniah 1:12).

decisions.choice: Idols ... People have to carry them ... hurt you ... help you
decisions.reason: Readable names the idols, says who carries them and puts doing harm and doing good as hurting and helping the people addressed (meaning decision m3).

decisions.choice: "elles" for the idols
decisions.reason: French refers to the idols with a feminine plural ("les idoles", and "la" for the carved tree, "une statue" understood), as the following verses do.

pt.R: {{divine_name:SENHOR|Javé}}, não há ninguém como {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}}. \q Tu és grande, e o {{deity_pronoun:teu|Teu}} nome é grande e poderoso.

decisions.choice: verses 6-8 and 10 as the Hebrew text has them
alternatives: omit verses 6-8 and 10, with verse 9 after the first part of verse 5
decisions.reason: The Hebrew text has these verses of praise between the descriptions of idol making. The old Greek translation of Jeremiah, which is shorter than the Hebrew throughout, does not have verses 6-8 and 10, and it places verse 9 inside verse 5, so the description of the idols runs on without a break. A fragment of Jeremiah found at Qumran seems to share the shorter form. The Hebrew text is followed here.

decisions.choice: the speaker turns to God in praise
decisions.reason: After God's words about the idols, the prophet speaks to God directly. The change is not marked in the Hebrew. The lines of praise (verses 6-7, 10, 12-16) alternate with the lines about idols, setting the living God against the made gods.

decisions.choice: there is none: an emphatic "none at all"
decisions.reason: The negative here has an extra preposition in front of it, which strengthens it: there is no one whatever like God (also verse 7).

decisions.choice: your name: God as he has made himself known
decisions.reason: A name stands for the person and his reputation. God's name is great in might because of what he has shown himself to be in his acts (Exodus 15:3; Psalm 8:2).

decisions.choice: LORD first
decisions.reason: Readable puts the call to God first so that the change of speaker is clear at once (meaning decision m2).

decisions.choice: the prophet turns to God: "lạy CHÚA" and "Ngài"
decisions.reason: The terms note's address for the prophet praying, used in the praise of verses 6-7 and 10 and the prayer of verses 23-25.

decisions.choice: the prophet turns to God in 합쇼체 (주님)
alternatives: | Verses 6-7 and 10 are praise addressed to God in the middle of the oracle against idols, so Korean switches to the polite speech of prayer; the lines about the idols stay in the plain style.

decisions.choice: tu (the prophet's praise of God, verses 6-7, 10, 12-16, and the prayer of 23-25)
decisions.reason: The poem against idols turns to God in praise (m2) and ends in prayer, so every word spoken to God takes "tu" with the deity_pronoun setting, as at 1:6 and 5:3; the words to the people around it keep "vocês" (verses 1-5, 11).

records.literal_gloss: Who not would fear you, king of the nations? For to you it is fitting; for among all [the] wise of the nations and in all their kingdom there is none like you.

en.L: Who would not fear {{deity_pronoun:you|You}}, King of the nations? \q For it is fitting for {{deity_pronoun:you|You}}; \q for among all the wise of the nations and in all their kingdom there is none like {{deity_pronoun:you|You}}.
en.B: Who would not fear {{deity_pronoun:you|You}}, King of the nations? \q That is {{deity_pronoun:your|Your}} due. \q Among all the wise of the nations and in all their kingdoms there is no one like {{deity_pronoun:you|You}}.
en.R: King of the nations, who would not fear {{deity_pronoun:you|You}}? \q Everyone ought to fear {{deity_pronoun:you|You}}. \q Among all the wise people of the nations, in all their kingdoms, there is no one like {{deity_pronoun:you|You}}.

es.L: ¿Quién no {{deity_pronoun:te|Te}} temería, Rey de las naciones? \q Porque a {{deity_pronoun:ti|Ti}} te corresponde; \q porque entre todos los sabios de las naciones y en todo su reino no hay nadie como {{deity_pronoun:tú|Tú}}.
es.B: ¿Quién no {{deity_pronoun:te|Te}} temería, Rey de las naciones? \q Eso es lo que {{deity_pronoun:te|Te}} corresponde. \q Entre todos los sabios de las naciones y en todos sus reinos no hay nadie como {{deity_pronoun:tú|Tú}}.
es.R: Rey de las naciones, ¿quién no {{deity_pronoun:te|Te}} temería? \q Todos deberían temer{{deity_pronoun:te|Te}}. \q Entre todos los sabios de las naciones, en todos sus reinos, no hay nadie como {{deity_pronoun:tú|Tú}}.

fr.L: Qui ne {{deity_pronoun:te|Te}} craindrait, Roi des nations ? \q Car cela {{deity_pronoun:te|Te}} revient ; \q car parmi tous les sages des nations et dans tout leur royaume, nul n’est comme {{deity_pronoun:toi|Toi}}.
fr.B: Qui ne {{deity_pronoun:te|Te}} craindrait pas, Roi des nations ? \q C’est ce qui {{deity_pronoun:t’|T’}}est dû. \q Parmi tous les sages des nations et dans tous leurs royaumes, personne n’est comme {{deity_pronoun:toi|Toi}}.
fr.R: Roi des nations, qui ne {{deity_pronoun:te|Te}} craindrait pas ? \q Tout le monde devrait {{deity_pronoun:te|Te}} craindre. \q Parmi tous les sages des nations, dans tous leurs royaumes, personne n’est comme {{deity_pronoun:toi|Toi}}.

sw.L: Ni nani asiyekuogopa {{deity_pronoun:wewe|Wewe}}, Mfalme wa mataifa? \q Kwa maana inakustahili {{deity_pronoun:wewe|Wewe}}; \q kwa maana kati ya wenye hekima wote wa mataifa na katika ufalme wao wote hakuna kama {{deity_pronoun:wewe|Wewe}}.
sw.B: Ni nani asiyekuogopa {{deity_pronoun:wewe|Wewe}}, Mfalme wa mataifa? \q Hiyo ndiyo haki {{deity_pronoun:yako|Yako}}. \q Kati ya wenye hekima wote wa mataifa na katika falme zao zote hakuna aliye kama {{deity_pronoun:wewe|Wewe}}.
sw.R: Mfalme wa mataifa, ni nani asiyekuogopa {{deity_pronoun:wewe|Wewe}}? \q Kila mtu anapaswa kukuogopa {{deity_pronoun:wewe|Wewe}}. \q Kati ya wenye hekima wote wa mataifa, katika falme zao zote, hakuna aliye kama {{deity_pronoun:wewe|Wewe}}.

vi.L: Ai lại không kính sợ {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}, hỡi Vua của các dân tộc? \q Vì điều ấy xứng hợp với {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}; \q vì trong tất cả những người khôn ngoan của các dân tộc và trong mọi vương quốc của họ, chẳng có ai giống như {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}.
vi.B: Ai lại không kính sợ {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}, lạy Vua của các dân tộc? \q Đó là điều {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} đáng được. \q Giữa mọi người khôn ngoan của các dân tộc và trong mọi vương quốc của họ, chẳng có ai giống như {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}.
vi.R: Lạy Vua của các dân tộc, ai lại không kính sợ {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}? \q Mọi người đều phải kính sợ {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}. \q Trong tất cả những người khôn ngoan của các dân tộc, trong mọi vương quốc của họ, không có ai giống như {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}.

ko.L: 민족들의 왕이시여, 누가 주님을 두려워하지 않겠습니까? \q 그것이 주님께 마땅합니다. \q 민족들의 모든 지혜로운 자들 가운데에도, 그들의 모든 나라 가운데에도 주님과 같은 분은 없습니다.
ko.B: 민족들의 왕이시여, 누가 주님을 두려워하지 않겠습니까? \q 주님은 그런 경외를 받으셔야 마땅합니다. \q 민족들의 모든 지혜로운 사람들 가운데에도, 그들의 모든 나라 가운데에도 주님과 같은 분은 없습니다.
ko.R: 민족들의 왕이시여, 누가 주님을 두려워하지 않겠습니까? \q 모든 사람이 주님을 두려워해야 마땅합니다. \q 민족들의 지혜로운 사람들 가운데에도, 그들의 모든 나라 가운데에도 주님과 같은 분은 없습니다.

pt.L: Quem não {{deity_pronoun:te|Te}} temeria, Rei das nações? \q Pois isso {{deity_pronoun:te|Te}} é devido; \q pois entre todos os sábios das nações e em todo o seu reino não há ninguém como {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}}.
pt.B: Quem não {{deity_pronoun:te|Te}} temeria, Rei das nações? \q Isso é {{deity_pronoun:teu|Teu}} por direito. \q Entre todos os sábios das nações e em todos os seus reinos não há ninguém como {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}}.
pt.R: Rei das nações, quem não {{deity_pronoun:te|Te}} temeria? \q Todos deveriam {{deity_pronoun:te|Te}} temer. \q Entre todos os sábios das nações, em todos os seus reinos, não há ninguém como {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}}.

decisions.choice: fear you: hold you in awe and honor
decisions.reason: To fear God is to stand in awe of him and give him the honor that is his (5:22, 24; Deuteronomy 10:12). The question expects the answer "no one".

decisions.choice: King of the nations: God rules all peoples, not only Israel
decisions.reason: The idols belong to the nations, but the nations themselves belong to God (Psalm 22:29; 47:9). The words are echoed in the song of Revelation 15:3-4: "Who will not fear, Lord ... King of the nations?"

decisions.choice: it is fitting: it is your due
decisions.reason: The verb appears only here. It means that something suits or is owed to someone: fear and honor are rightly God's.

decisions.choice: their kingdom: their royal rule, all their realms
decisions.reason: The noun is singular, "their kingship" or "realm", taken together for all the kingdoms of the wise men of the nations.

decisions.choice: That is your due (Balanced); Everyone ought to fear you (Readable); kingdoms
decisions.reason: Balanced and Readable say what is fitting in plain words; Readable repeats the verb "fear" from the question so the link is clear. Both use the plural "kingdoms" for the singular collective (meaning decision m4).

decisions.choice: Quem não te temeria, Rei das nações?
decisions.reason: The song of Revelation 15:3-4 echoes these words (m2), and Portuguese keeps the verb Revelation's Portuguese has, "temer", with "Rei das nações" as the title; the conditional "temeria" follows the Hebrew question here, where Revelation looks ahead.

source.text: וּבְאַחַ֖ת יִבְעֲר֣וּ וְיִכְסָ֑לוּ מוּסַ֥ר הֲבָלִ֖ים עֵ֥ץ הֽוּא׃

records.literal_gloss: And in one they are stupid and they are foolish; [the] instruction of futilities, wood [is] it.

en.L: And all together they are stupid and foolish; \q the instruction of futilities: it [is] wood.
en.B: They are senseless and foolish, all of them alike; \q the teaching of empty idols is only a block of wood.
en.R: All of them are stupid and foolish. \q Their idols are only wood; they have nothing to teach.

es.L: Y todos a una son necios e insensatos; \q la instrucción de las vanidades: madera [es].
es.B: Son necios e insensatos, todos por igual; \q la enseñanza de los ídolos vacíos no es más que un trozo de madera.
es.R: Todos ellos son tontos e insensatos. \q Sus ídolos son solo madera; no tienen nada que enseñar.

fr.L: Et tous ensemble ils sont stupides et insensés ; \q l’enseignement des vanités : c’[est] du bois.
fr.B: Ils sont stupides et insensés, tous autant qu’ils sont ; \q l’enseignement des idoles vaines n’est qu’un morceau de bois.
fr.R: Ils sont tous stupides et insensés. \q Leurs idoles ne sont que du bois ; elles n’ont rien à enseigner.

sw.L: Na wote pamoja ni wajinga na wapumbavu; \q mafundisho ya ubatili: ni mti.
sw.B: Wote kwa pamoja hawana akili, ni wapumbavu; \q mafundisho ya sanamu tupu ni gogo la mti tu.
sw.R: Wote ni wajinga na wapumbavu. \q Sanamu zao ni mbao tu; hazina chochote cha kufundisha.

vi.L: Tất cả chúng đều ngu muội và dại dột; \q sự dạy dỗ của những thứ hư không: [chỉ là] gỗ.
vi.B: Tất cả chúng đều thiếu hiểu biết và dại dột như nhau; \q sự dạy dỗ của các thần tượng hư không chỉ là một khúc gỗ.
vi.R: Tất cả chúng đều ngu dại và khờ khạo. \q Thần tượng của chúng chỉ là gỗ; chúng chẳng dạy được gì.

ko.L: 그들은 모두 함께 어리석고 미련하다. \q 헛된 것들의 가르침, 그것은 나무다.
ko.B: 그들은 하나같이 어리석고 미련하다. \q 헛된 우상들의 가르침은 나무토막에 불과하다.
ko.R: 그들은 모두 어리석고 미련하다. \q 그들의 우상은 나무일 뿐이다. 우상은 아무것도 가르칠 수 없다.

pt.L: E todos juntos são estúpidos e insensatos; \q a instrução dos sopros: madeira [é] ela.
pt.B: São insensatos e tolos, todos igualmente; \q o ensino de ídolos vazios não passa de um pedaço de madeira.
pt.R: Todos eles são estúpidos e tolos. \q Os seus ídolos são só madeira; não têm nada para ensinar.

decisions.choice: they: the wise men and peoples of the nations (verse 7)
decisions.reason: The verse follows on from "the wise of the nations". For all their wisdom, they are senseless together, "as one" (the meaning of the phrase translated "all together").

decisions.choice: stupid and foolish: dull as an animal, without sense
decisions.reason: The first verb comes from the word for cattle and means to be brutish, without understanding. It returns in verse 14 for idol makers and in verse 21 for Judah's own leaders.

decisions.choice: the instruction of futilities: it is wood: what idols teach is no more than the wood they are
alternatives: the discipline of worthless things is wood
an idol's teaching is a stick of wood
decisions.reason: The phrase is short and hard. It probably means that whatever guidance people seek from idols comes from a piece of wood and is worth nothing. It could also be read "the discipline of idols is wood", that is, the idol worshipper's training is worthless, or as a mocking reply: "the idols' instruction? It is a stick!"

decisions.choice: futilities: idols, called empty breaths
decisions.reason: The plural of the word for "breath" in verse 3 is a scornful name for idols (8:19; 14:22; Deuteronomy 32:21).

decisions.choice: empty idols ... only a block of wood (Balanced); Their idols are only wood; they have nothing to teach (Readable)
decisions.reason: Balanced and Readable name the idols and spell out that their teaching is as empty as the wood they are carved from (meaning decision m3).

source.text: כֶּ֣סֶף מְרֻקָּ֞ע מִתַּרְשִׁ֣ישׁ יוּבָ֗א וְזָהָב֙ מֵֽאוּפָ֔ז מַעֲשֵׂ֥ה חָרָ֖שׁ וִידֵ֣י צוֹרֵ֑ף תְּכֵ֤לֶת וְאַרְגָּמָן֙ לְבוּשָׁ֔ם מַעֲשֵׂ֥ה חֲכָמִ֖ים כֻּלָּֽם׃

records.literal_gloss: Silver beaten from Tarshish is brought, and gold from Uphaz, [the] work of a craftsman and of [the] hands of a smith; blue and purple [is] their clothing; [the] work of skilled [ones are] all of them.

en.L: Silver beaten thin is brought from Tarshish, and gold from Uphaz, \q the work of a craftsman and of the hands of a smith; \q blue and purple [are] their clothing; \q the work of skilled [men are] all of them.
en.B: Silver hammered into sheets is brought from Tarshish, and gold from Uphaz; \q they are the work of a craftsman and the hands of a goldsmith. \q Their robes are blue and purple; \q every one of them is the work of experts.
en.R: Thin sheets of silver are brought from Tarshish and gold from Uphaz. \q Craftsmen and goldsmiths make them into idols. \q The idols are dressed in blue and purple cloth. \q Skilled workers make every one of them.

es.L: Plata batida se trae de Tarsis, y oro de Ufaz, \q obra del artesano y de las manos del fundidor; \q azul y púrpura [es] su vestido; \q obra de expertos [son] todos ellos.
es.B: Se trae de Tarsis plata martillada en láminas, y oro de Ufaz; \q son obra de un artesano y de las manos de un orfebre. \q Sus vestidos son azules y púrpura; \q todos ellos son obra de expertos.
es.R: Traen láminas finas de plata de Tarsis y oro de Ufaz. \q Los artesanos y los orfebres los convierten en ídolos. \q A los ídolos los visten con telas azules y moradas. \q Todos ellos son hechos por obreros hábiles.

fr.L: De l’argent battu en feuilles est apporté de Tarsis, et de l’or d’Ouphaz, \q ouvrage de l’artisan et des mains de l’orfèvre ; \q de pourpre violette et de pourpre rouge [est] leur vêtement ; \q tous [sont] l’ouvrage de gens habiles.
fr.B: On apporte de Tarsis de l’argent martelé en feuilles, et de l’or d’Ouphaz ; \q c’est l’ouvrage d’un artisan et des mains d’un orfèvre. \q Leurs vêtements sont de pourpre violette et rouge ; \q toutes sont l’ouvrage d’experts.
fr.R: On apporte de Tarsis de fines feuilles d’argent, et de l’or d’Ouphaz. \q Des artisans et des orfèvres en font des idoles. \q On habille les idoles de tissu violet et rouge. \q Ce sont des ouvriers habiles qui les fabriquent toutes.

sw.L: Fedha iliyofuliwa kuwa nyembamba inaletwa kutoka Tarshishi, na dhahabu kutoka Ufazi, \q kazi ya fundi na ya mikono ya mfua chuma; \q nguo zao [ni] za rangi ya samawati na zambarau; \q zote [ni] kazi ya [watu] stadi.
sw.B: Fedha iliyofuliwa kuwa mabamba inaletwa kutoka Tarshishi, na dhahabu kutoka Ufazi; \q ni kazi ya fundi na ya mikono ya mfua dhahabu. \q Mavazi yao ni ya samawati na zambarau; \q kila mmoja wao ni kazi ya mafundi stadi.
sw.R: Mabamba membamba ya fedha yanaletwa kutoka Tarshishi, na dhahabu kutoka Ufazi. \q Mafundi na wafua dhahabu wanayafanya kuwa sanamu. \q Sanamu hizo zinavalishwa nguo za samawati na zambarau. \q Mafundi stadi wanatengeneza kila moja yao.

vi.L: Bạc dát mỏng được đem đến từ Ta-rê-si, và vàng từ U-pha, \q là công việc của thợ khéo và của tay thợ kim hoàn; \q y phục của chúng [bằng vải] xanh và tím; \q tất cả đều là công việc của những người thành thạo.
vi.B: Bạc được dát thành lá đem đến từ Ta-rê-si, vàng đem đến từ U-pha; \q chúng là công việc của thợ khéo và bàn tay thợ kim hoàn. \q Áo của chúng màu xanh và tím; \q tất cả đều do những người thợ lành nghề làm ra.
vi.R: Những lá bạc mỏng được đem đến từ Ta-rê-si, và vàng từ U-pha. \q Thợ khéo và thợ kim hoàn làm chúng thành thần tượng. \q Thần tượng được mặc áo vải màu xanh và tím. \q Tất cả đều do thợ lành nghề làm ra.

ko.L: 다시스에서 얇게 두드린 은을 가져오고 우바스에서 금을 가져온다. \q 장인과 대장장이의 손으로 만든 것이다. \q 청색과 자주색 옷을 입혔으니 \q 모두 솜씨 좋은 자들이 만든 것이다.
ko.B: 다시스에서 두드려 편 은판을 가져오고 우바스에서 금을 가져온다. \q 그것은 장인과 금세공인의 손으로 만든 것이다. \q 그것들은 청색과 자주색 옷을 입었고, \q 하나같이 전문가들이 만든 것이다.
ko.R: 사람들은 다시스에서 얇은 은판을 가져오고 우바스에서 금을 가져온다. \q 장인들과 금세공인들이 그것으로 우상을 만든다. \q 우상들에게 청색과 자주색 옷을 입힌다. \q 솜씨 좋은 일꾼들이 우상을 하나하나 만든다.

pt.L: Prata batida é trazida de Társis, e ouro de Ufaz, \q obra do artífice e das mãos do fundidor; \q azul e roxo [são] as suas vestes; \q obra de [homens] hábeis [são] todos eles.
pt.B: Prata batida em lâminas é trazida de Társis, e ouro de Ufaz; \q são obra de artesão e das mãos do ourives. \q As suas roupas são azuis e roxas; \q todos eles são obra de especialistas.
pt.R: Lâminas finas de prata são trazidas de Társis, e ouro de Ufaz. \q Artesãos e ourives fazem deles ídolos. \q Os ídolos são vestidos com panos azuis e roxos. \q Trabalhadores habilidosos fazem cada um deles.

decisions.choice: Tarshish: a distant port in the far west, known for its silver
decisions.reason: Tarshish traded in silver, iron, tin and lead (Ezekiel 27:12). It lay far across the Mediterranean, perhaps in Spain. The materials of the idols are brought from the ends of the known world, at great cost.

decisions.choice: Uphaz: a place known for gold, otherwise unknown
decisions.reason: The name appears only here and in Daniel 10:5 ("fine gold of Uphaz"). Some ancient translations read Ophir, the well-known land of gold (1 Kings 9:28), whose name differs by little in Hebrew writing.

decisions.choice: blue and purple: costly dyed cloth, the colors of kings and of the tabernacle
decisions.reason: These dyes, made from sea snails, were very expensive. They were used for royal robes (Judges 8:26) and for the curtains of the tabernacle (Exodus 26:1). The idols are dressed like kings.

decisions.choice: skilled: the same word as "wise" in verse 7
decisions.reason: The word means "wise" and is used of skilled workers (Exodus 28:3; Isaiah 40:20). The wisdom of the nations (verse 7) turns out to be the skill of the craftsmen who make their gods.

decisions.choice: smith (Literal); goldsmith (Balanced, Readable)
decisions.reason: The word means one who refines and works metal. Literal says "smith"; Balanced and Readable say "goldsmith", since he works the gold of this verse. Verse 14 has the same word.

decisions.choice: make them into idols ... The idols are dressed
decisions.reason: Readable says what the silver and gold are made into and who is dressed, which the Hebrew leaves to the context.

decisions.choice: "Tarsis", "Ufaz"
decisions.reason: Tarshish in its published Spanish form (1 Kings 10:22); Uphaz in the matching spelling.

decisions.choice: Tarshishi, Ufazi
decisions.reason: Tarshish in the form of the terms note and Psalm 48:8; Uphaz in the same pattern.

decisions.choice: "l’orfèvre" at every level
decisions.reason: French "orfèvre" names a worker of precious metal, which fits both the silver and the gold here; one word serves all three levels.

decisions.choice: "Ta-rê-si" (Tarshish); "U-pha" (Uphaz)
decisions.reason: Tarshish as published (2 Chronicles 9:21); its "Ta" is part of the name and never takes the deity_pronoun span (terms note). Uphaz is new and written from the Hebrew.

decisions.choice: Társis; Ufaz; fundidor (L), ourives (B, R); azul e roxo
decisions.reason: Tarshish takes the form Isaiah 23:1 gives it in Portuguese, and Uphaz is written as Portuguese spells its sounds, kept apart from Ofir (m2). The metalworker is "fundidor" at Literal and "ourives" at Balanced and Readable, as the English says "smith" and "goldsmith" (r-en-1). The two dyes (m3) take the words of the tabernacle cloth in Exodus 26:1, "azul" and "roxo".

source.text: וַֽיהוָ֤ה אֱלֹהִים֙ אֱמֶ֔ת הֽוּא־אֱלֹהִ֥ים חַיִּ֖ים וּמֶ֣לֶךְ עוֹלָ֑ם מִקִּצְפּוֹ֙ תִּרְעַ֣שׁ הָאָ֔רֶץ וְלֹֽא־יָכִ֥לוּ גוֹיִ֖ם זַעְמֽוֹ׃ס

records.literal_gloss: But Yahweh [is] God truth; he [is] God living and king of perpetuity. From his wrath shakes the earth, and not endure nations his indignation.

en.L: But {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} [is] God [in] truth; \q {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} [is] the living God and everlasting King. \q At {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} wrath the earth quakes, \q and nations cannot endure {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} indignation.
en.B: But {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} is God in truth; \q {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} is the living God, the eternal King. \q When {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} is angry, the earth quakes, \q and the nations cannot withstand {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} fury.
en.R: But {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} is the one true God. \q He is the God who is alive, the King who rules forever. \q When {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} is angry, the earth shakes. \q The nations cannot stand up to {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} anger.

es.L: Pero {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}} [es] Dios [en] verdad; \q {{deity_pronoun:él|Él}} [es] el Dios vivo y Rey eterno. \q Ante {{deity_pronoun:su|Su}} ira tiembla la tierra, \q y las naciones no pueden soportar {{deity_pronoun:su|Su}} indignación.
es.B: Pero {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}} es Dios en verdad; \q {{deity_pronoun:él|Él}} es el Dios vivo, el Rey eterno. \q Cuando {{deity_pronoun:él|Él}} se enoja, la tierra tiembla, \q y las naciones no pueden resistir {{deity_pronoun:su|Su}} furor.
es.R: Pero {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}} es el único Dios verdadero. \q Es el Dios que está vivo, el Rey que reina para siempre. \q Cuando {{deity_pronoun:él|Él}} se enoja, la tierra tiembla. \q Las naciones no pueden hacer frente a {{deity_pronoun:su|Su}} ira.

fr.L: Mais {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} [est] le Dieu de vérité ; \q {{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} [est] le Dieu vivant et le Roi éternel. \q Devant {{deity_pronoun:sa|Sa}} fureur la terre tremble, \q et les nations ne supportent pas {{deity_pronoun:son|Son}} indignation.
fr.B: Mais {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} est le vrai Dieu ; \q {{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} est le Dieu vivant, le Roi éternel. \q Quand {{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} se met en colère, la terre tremble, \q et les nations ne peuvent pas résister à {{deity_pronoun:sa|Sa}} fureur.
fr.R: Mais {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} est le seul vrai Dieu. \q C’est le Dieu qui est vivant, le Roi qui règne pour toujours. \q Quand {{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} est en colère, la terre tremble. \q Les nations ne peuvent pas résister à {{deity_pronoun:sa|Sa}} colère.

sw.L: Lakini {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} [ni] Mungu [wa] kweli; \q {{deity_pronoun:yeye|Yeye}} [ni] Mungu aliye hai na Mfalme wa milele. \q Kwa ghadhabu {{deity_pronoun:yake|Yake}} dunia inatetemeka, \q wala mataifa hayawezi kustahimili hasira {{deity_pronoun:yake|Yake}}.
sw.B: Lakini {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} ni Mungu wa kweli; \q {{deity_pronoun:yeye|Yeye}} ni Mungu aliye hai, Mfalme wa milele. \q Anapokasirika, dunia inatetemeka, \q wala mataifa hayawezi kustahimili ghadhabu {{deity_pronoun:yake|Yake}}.
sw.R: Lakini {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} ndiye Mungu pekee wa kweli. \q Yeye ni Mungu aliye hai, Mfalme anayetawala milele. \q Anapokasirika, dunia inatetemeka. \q Mataifa hayawezi kusimama mbele ya hasira {{deity_pronoun:yake|Yake}}.

vi.L: Nhưng {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} [là] Đức Chúa Trời chân thật; \q Ngài [là] Đức Chúa Trời hằng sống và là Vua đời đời. \q Trước cơn thịnh nộ {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}, đất rúng động, \q và các dân tộc không chịu nổi cơn phẫn nộ của {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}.
vi.B: Nhưng {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} là Đức Chúa Trời thật; \q Ngài là Đức Chúa Trời hằng sống, là Vua đời đời. \q Khi {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} nổi giận, đất rúng động, \q và các dân tộc không chịu nổi cơn thịnh nộ của {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}.
vi.R: Nhưng {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} là Đức Chúa Trời thật duy nhất. \q Ngài là Đức Chúa Trời hằng sống, là Vua cai trị đời đời. \q Khi {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} nổi giận, đất rung chuyển. \q Các dân tộc không thể đứng nổi trước cơn giận của {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}.

ko.L: 그러나 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}는 참 하나님이시다. \q 그분은 살아 계신 하나님이시며 영원한 왕이시다. \q 그분이 진노하시면 땅이 진동하고, \q 민족들이 그분의 분노를 견디지 못한다.
ko.B: 그러나 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}는 참되신 하나님이시다. \q 그분은 살아 계신 하나님, 영원한 왕이시다. \q 그분이 노하시면 땅이 흔들리고, \q 민족들이 그분의 진노를 견디지 못한다.
ko.R: 그러나 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}는 오직 한 분이신 참 하나님이시다. \q 그분은 살아 계신 하나님, 영원히 다스리시는 왕이시다. \q 그분이 노하시면 땅이 흔들린다. \q 민족들은 그분의 분노를 당해 낼 수 없다.

pt.L: Mas {{divine_name:o SENHOR|Javé}} [é] Deus [em] verdade; \q {{deity_pronoun:ele|Ele}} [é] o Deus vivo e Rei eterno. \q Diante do {{deity_pronoun:seu|Seu}} furor a terra treme, \q e as nações não suportam a {{deity_pronoun:sua|Sua}} indignação.
pt.B: Mas {{divine_name:o SENHOR|Javé}} é o Deus verdadeiro; \q {{deity_pronoun:ele|Ele}} é o Deus vivo, o Rei eterno. \q Quando {{deity_pronoun:ele|Ele}} se ira, a terra treme, \q e as nações não resistem à {{deity_pronoun:sua|Sua}} fúria.
pt.R: Mas {{divine_name:o SENHOR|Javé}} é o único Deus verdadeiro. \q Ele é o Deus que está vivo, o Rei que reina para sempre. \q Quando {{deity_pronoun:ele|Ele}} fica irado, a terra treme. \q As nações não conseguem enfrentar a {{deity_pronoun:sua|Sua}} ira.

decisions.choice: God in truth: the true God, real and faithful
decisions.reason: "God of truth" means the God who is real and can be relied on. It answers verse 14, where the idol is called a "lie".

decisions.choice: the living God: God who lives and acts
decisions.reason: Against the idols, which have no breath (verse 14) and cannot move (verse 5), the LORD is alive and acts (23:36; Deuteronomy 5:26; 1 Samuel 17:26).

decisions.choice: everlasting King: king for all time
decisions.reason: The word means a long, unbounded time. God's rule has no end, unlike the kings of the nations (Psalm 10:16; 29:10).

decisions.choice: verse 10 as the Hebrew text has it
decisions.reason: This verse is also missing from the old Greek translation; see verse 6.

decisions.choice: the one true God ... the God who is alive
decisions.reason: Readable spells out what "true" and "living" mean here (meaning decisions m1 and m2).

source.text: כִּדְנָה֙ תֵּאמְר֣וּן לְה֔וֹם אֱלָ֣הַיָּ֔א דִּֽי־שְׁמַיָּ֥א וְאַרְקָ֖א לָ֣א עֲבַ֑דוּ יֵאבַ֧דוּ מֵֽאַרְעָ֛א וּמִן־תְּח֥וֹת שְׁמַיָּ֖א אֵֽלֶּה׃ס

records.literal_gloss: As this you will say to them: the gods who the heavens and the earth not made will perish from the earth and from under the heavens these.

en.L: Thus you shall say to them: \q "The gods who did not make the heavens and the earth \q will perish from the earth and from under these heavens."
en.B: This is what you are to say to them: \q "The gods that did not make heaven and earth \q will perish from the earth and from beneath these heavens."
en.R: Tell the nations this: \q "These gods did not make the sky and the earth. \q So they will disappear from the earth and from under the sky."

es.L: Así les {{plural_you:dirán|diréis}}: \q «Los dioses que no hicieron los cielos y la tierra \q perecerán de la tierra y de debajo de estos cielos».
es.B: Esto es lo que {{plural_you:deben|debéis}} decirles: \q «Los dioses que no hicieron el cielo y la tierra \q desaparecerán de la tierra y de debajo de estos cielos».
es.R: {{plural_you:Díganles|Decidles}} esto a las naciones: \q «Estos dioses no hicieron el cielo ni la tierra. \q Por eso desaparecerán de la tierra y de debajo del cielo».

fr.L: Vous leur parlerez ainsi : \q « Les dieux qui n’ont pas fait les cieux et la terre \q périront de la terre et de dessous ces cieux. »
fr.B: Voici ce que vous leur direz : \q « Les dieux qui n’ont pas fait le ciel et la terre \q disparaîtront de la terre et de dessous ces cieux. »
fr.R: Dites ceci aux nations : \q « Ces dieux n’ont pas fait le ciel et la terre. \q Alors ils disparaîtront de la terre et de dessous le ciel. »

sw.L: Hivi ndivyo mtakavyowaambia: \q "Miungu ambayo haikuziumba mbingu na nchi \q itaangamia kutoka duniani na kutoka chini ya mbingu hizi."
sw.B: Hivi ndivyo mtakavyowaambia: \q "Miungu ambayo haikuziumba mbingu na dunia \q itaangamia kutoka duniani na kutoka chini ya mbingu hizi."
sw.R: Yaambieni mataifa hivi: \q "Miungu hii haikuumba anga na dunia. \q Kwa hiyo itatoweka kutoka duniani na kutoka chini ya anga."

vi.L: Các ngươi hãy nói với chúng thế này: \q "Các thần không làm nên trời và đất \q sẽ bị diệt khỏi đất và khỏi dưới các tầng trời này."
vi.B: Đây là điều các ngươi phải nói với chúng: \q "Những thần không dựng nên trời và đất \q sẽ bị tiêu diệt khỏi mặt đất và khỏi dưới các tầng trời này."
vi.R: Hãy nói với các dân tộc điều này: \q "Những thần này không dựng nên bầu trời và mặt đất. \q Vì thế chúng sẽ biến mất khỏi mặt đất và khỏi dưới bầu trời."

ko.L: 너희는 그들에게 이와 같이 말하여라. \q "하늘과 땅을 만들지 않은 신들은 \q 땅에서, 이 하늘 아래에서 사라질 것이다."
ko.B: 너희는 그들에게 이렇게 말해야 한다. \q "하늘과 땅을 만들지 않은 신들은 \q 땅에서, 이 하늘 아래에서 망할 것이다."
ko.R: 민족들에게 이렇게 말하여라. \q "이 신들은 하늘과 땅을 만들지 않았다. \q 그러니 그것들은 땅에서, 하늘 아래에서 사라질 것이다."

pt.L: Assim vocês lhes dirão: \q "Os deuses que não fizeram os céus e a terra \q perecerão da terra e de debaixo destes céus."
pt.B: É isto que vocês devem dizer a eles: \q "Os deuses que não fizeram o céu e a terra \q desaparecerão da terra e de debaixo destes céus."
pt.R: Digam isto às nações: \q "Estes deuses não fizeram o céu e a terra. \q Por isso vão desaparecer da terra e de debaixo do céu."

decisions.choice: this verse is in Aramaic
alternatives: a later note added in Aramaic
decisions.reason: This is the only verse in Jeremiah written in Aramaic, the common language of the Assyrian, Babylonian and Persian empires (2 Kings 18:26), which the nations around the exiles spoke. It reads as a short answer given to God's people to say to the nations in their own tongue. Why it stands here in Aramaic is not certain: it may be meant for use in exile, or it may be a note copied into the text. The Hebrew returns in verse 12.

decisions.choice: did not make ... will perish: a play on words
decisions.reason: In Aramaic the verbs "made" and "will perish" sound alike. The verse also uses two different forms of the word for "earth". The gods that did not make the world will be unmade from it.

decisions.choice: will perish: a statement of what will happen
decisions.reason: The verb form can state what will happen or wish it ("may they perish"). It is read as a sure statement, matching "they will perish" in verse 15.

decisions.choice: these: going with "heavens"
decisions.reason: The last word, "these", most naturally goes with "heavens", the heavens that the speaker and the hearers see. It could also point back to the gods: "... from under the heavens, these [gods]".

decisions.choice: the words to be said in quotation marks
decisions.reason: The words the people are told to say are a quotation inside the oracle, so they take double quotation marks.

decisions.choice: the nations ... So
decisions.reason: Readable says that "them" are the nations who worship these gods, and adds "So" to show the link between not making the world and perishing from it.

decisions.choice: "dirán" / "diréis" in a plural_you span
decisions.reason: This verse is in Aramaic and the verb is plural; the words to be said take quotation marks, as in the English.

decisions.choice: mtakavyowaambia (plural)
decisions.reason: The verse is in Aramaic and speaks to the people in the plural; Swahili shows the plural in the verb, which the English "you" cannot.

decisions.choice: vocês lhes dirão (the people told what to say to the nations)
decisions.reason: The verb is plural (the people, as in verses 1-5), so Portuguese says "vocês". The verse is in Aramaic (m1), and its play on "made" and "perish" (m2) cannot be kept in Portuguese; the meaning notes say so.

source.text: עֹשֵׂ֥ה אֶ֨רֶץ֙ בְּכֹח֔וֹ מֵכִ֥ין תֵּבֵ֖ל בְּחָכְמָת֑וֹ וּבִתְבוּנָת֖וֹ נָטָ֥ה שָׁמָֽיִם׃

records.literal_gloss: [He is the] maker of [the] earth by his power, establisher of [the] world by his wisdom, and by his understanding he stretched out [the] heavens.

en.L: [He is] the maker of the earth by {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} power, \q who established the world by {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} wisdom, \q and by {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} understanding {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} stretched out the heavens.
en.B: It is {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} who made the earth by {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} power, \q who set the world firm by {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} wisdom, \q and by {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} understanding spread out the heavens.
en.R: God made the earth by {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} power. \q He set the world firmly in place by {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} wisdom. \q He used {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} understanding to spread out the sky.

es.L: [Él es] el que hizo la tierra con {{deity_pronoun:su|Su}} poder, \q el que afirmó el mundo con {{deity_pronoun:su|Su}} sabiduría, \q y con {{deity_pronoun:su|Su}} inteligencia extendió los cielos.
es.B: Es {{deity_pronoun:él|Él}} quien hizo la tierra con {{deity_pronoun:su|Su}} poder, \q quien afirmó el mundo con {{deity_pronoun:su|Su}} sabiduría, \q y con {{deity_pronoun:su|Su}} inteligencia extendió los cielos.
es.R: Dios hizo la tierra con {{deity_pronoun:su|Su}} poder. \q Afirmó el mundo con {{deity_pronoun:su|Su}} sabiduría. \q Usó {{deity_pronoun:su|Su}} inteligencia para extender el cielo.

fr.L: [Il a] fait la terre par {{deity_pronoun:sa|Sa}} puissance, \q affermi le monde par {{deity_pronoun:sa|Sa}} sagesse, \q et par {{deity_pronoun:son|Son}} intelligence {{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} a déployé les cieux.
fr.B: C’est {{deity_pronoun:lui|Lui}} qui a fait la terre par {{deity_pronoun:sa|Sa}} puissance, \q qui a établi le monde par {{deity_pronoun:sa|Sa}} sagesse, \q et qui, par {{deity_pronoun:son|Son}} intelligence, a déployé les cieux.
fr.R: Dieu a fait la terre par {{deity_pronoun:sa|Sa}} puissance. \q Il a solidement établi le monde par {{deity_pronoun:sa|Sa}} sagesse. \q Il s’est servi de {{deity_pronoun:son|Son}} intelligence pour déployer le ciel.

sw.L: [Yeye ndiye] aliyeiumba dunia kwa uweza {{deity_pronoun:wake|Wake}}, \q aliyeuthibitisha ulimwengu kwa hekima {{deity_pronoun:yake|Yake}}, \q na kwa ufahamu {{deity_pronoun:wake|Wake}} alizitandaza mbingu.
sw.B: Ni {{deity_pronoun:yeye|Yeye}} aliyeiumba dunia kwa uweza {{deity_pronoun:wake|Wake}}, \q aliyeuweka ulimwengu imara kwa hekima {{deity_pronoun:yake|Yake}}, \q na kwa ufahamu {{deity_pronoun:wake|Wake}} akazitandaza mbingu.
sw.R: Mungu aliiumba dunia kwa uweza {{deity_pronoun:wake|Wake}}. \q Aliuweka ulimwengu imara mahali pake kwa hekima {{deity_pronoun:yake|Yake}}. \q Alitumia ufahamu {{deity_pronoun:wake|Wake}} kulitandaza anga.

vi.L: [Ngài là] Đấng đã làm nên đất bởi quyền năng {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}, \q đã lập thế gian bởi sự khôn ngoan {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}, \q và bởi sự thông sáng {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}, {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} đã giương các tầng trời ra.
vi.B: Chính {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} đã dựng nên đất bởi quyền năng {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}, \q đã lập thế giới vững bền bởi sự khôn ngoan {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}, \q và giương các tầng trời ra bởi sự thông sáng {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}.
vi.R: Đức Chúa Trời đã dựng nên đất bởi quyền năng {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}. \q Ngài đặt thế giới vững vàng bởi sự khôn ngoan {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}. \q Ngài dùng sự thông sáng của {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} mà giăng bầu trời ra.

ko.L: 그분은 자기 능력으로 땅을 만드시고, \q 자기 지혜로 세상을 세우시고, \q 자기 명철로 하늘을 펼치신 분이시다.
ko.B: 바로 그분이 그분의 능력으로 땅을 만드셨고, \q 그분의 지혜로 세상을 굳게 세우셨으며, \q 그분의 명철로 하늘을 펼치셨다.
ko.R: 하나님께서 그분의 능력으로 땅을 만드셨다. \q 그분은 그분의 지혜로 세상을 든든히 세우셨다. \q 그분은 그분의 깨달음으로 하늘을 펼치셨다.

pt.L: [Ele é] o que fez a terra com o {{deity_pronoun:seu|Seu}} poder, \q que firmou o mundo com a {{deity_pronoun:sua|Sua}} sabedoria, \q e com o {{deity_pronoun:seu|Seu}} entendimento estendeu os céus.
pt.B: Foi {{deity_pronoun:ele|Ele}} quem fez a terra com o {{deity_pronoun:seu|Seu}} poder, \q quem firmou o mundo com a {{deity_pronoun:sua|Sua}} sabedoria \q e com o {{deity_pronoun:seu|Seu}} entendimento estendeu os céus.
pt.R: Deus fez a terra com o {{deity_pronoun:seu|Seu}} poder. \q Firmou o mundo no lugar com a {{deity_pronoun:sua|Sua}} sabedoria. \q Usou o {{deity_pronoun:seu|Seu}} entendimento para estender o céu.

decisions.choice: maker ... establisher: the LORD described by what he did
decisions.reason: The Hebrew returns after the Aramaic verse and begins with words describing the LORD of verse 10. Against the gods who did not make the heavens and the earth (verse 11), he is the one who did.

decisions.choice: verses 12-16 are repeated in 51:15-19
decisions.reason: These five verses appear again almost word for word in the oracle against Babylon (51:15-19). The thought of God founding the world by wisdom and understanding is also in Proverbs 3:19 and Psalm 104:24; stretching out the heavens in Isaiah 40:22; 42:5.

decisions.choice: world: the inhabited earth
decisions.reason: The word names the dry land where people live, set firm by God (Psalm 93:1; 96:10).

decisions.choice: God
decisions.reason: Readable names the subject, since a new sentence begins and the verse before it spoke of the false gods.

decisions.choice: the same Swahili at each level in 51:15-19
decisions.reason: Verses 12-16 return in 51:15-19 (meaning decision m2); each level is to keep this wording there.

decisions.choice: verses 12-16 worded to serve 51:15-19 as well
decisions.reason: These five verses return almost word for word in 51:15-19 (m2). Where the Hebrew is the same there, its Portuguese should take these sentences level by level, changing only where the Hebrew does.

source.text: לְק֨וֹל תִּתּ֜וֹ הֲמ֥וֹן מַ֨יִם֙ בַּשָּׁמַ֔יִם וַיַּעֲלֶ֥ה נְשִׂאִ֖ים מִקְצֵ֣ה הָאָ֑רֶץ בְּרָקִ֤ים לַמָּטָר֙ עָשָׂ֔ה וַיּ֥וֹצֵא ר֖וּחַ מֵאֹצְרֹתָֽיו׃

records.literal_gloss: At [the] sound of his giving, a roar of waters in the heavens, and he makes go up clouds from [the] end of the earth; lightnings for the rain he makes, and he brings out wind from his storehouses.

en.L: At the sound of {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} giving forth [{{deity_pronoun:his|His}} voice], [there is] a roar of waters in the heavens, \q and {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} makes clouds rise from the end of the earth; \q {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} makes lightning for the rain \q and brings out wind from {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} storehouses.
en.B: When {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} thunders, the waters in the heavens roar; \q {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} raises the clouds from the far edges of the earth. \q He makes lightning flash with the rain \q and brings the wind out of {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} storehouses.
en.R: When {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} thunders, the waters in the sky roar. \q He makes clouds rise up from far away at the edge of the world. \q He sends lightning with the rain. \q He brings out the wind from the places where {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} keeps it.

es.L: Al sonido de {{deity_pronoun:su|Su}} [voz], [hay] estruendo de aguas en los cielos, \q y {{deity_pronoun:él|Él}} hace subir las nubes desde el extremo de la tierra; \q {{deity_pronoun:él|Él}} hace los relámpagos para la lluvia \q y saca el viento de {{deity_pronoun:sus|Sus}} depósitos.
es.B: Cuando {{deity_pronoun:él|Él}} truena, rugen las aguas en los cielos; \q {{deity_pronoun:él|Él}} levanta las nubes desde los confines de la tierra. \q Él hace brillar los relámpagos con la lluvia \q y saca el viento de {{deity_pronoun:sus|Sus}} depósitos.
es.R: Cuando {{deity_pronoun:él|Él}} truena, rugen las aguas en el cielo. \q Él hace que las nubes suban desde muy lejos, en el borde del mundo. \q Envía los relámpagos con la lluvia. \q Saca el viento de los lugares donde {{deity_pronoun:él|Él}} lo guarda.

fr.L: Au bruit de {{deity_pronoun:son|Son}} [cri], [il y a] un grondement d’eaux dans les cieux, \q et {{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} fait monter les nuées de l’extrémité de la terre ; \q {{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} fait les éclairs pour la pluie \q et fait sortir le vent de {{deity_pronoun:ses|Ses}} réserves.
fr.B: Quand {{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} fait entendre le tonnerre, les eaux grondent dans le ciel ; \q {{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} fait monter les nuages des extrémités de la terre. \q Il fait jaillir les éclairs avec la pluie \q et fait sortir le vent de {{deity_pronoun:ses|Ses}} réserves.
fr.R: Quand {{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} fait gronder le tonnerre, les eaux du ciel grondent. \q Il fait monter les nuages de très loin, du bout du monde. \q Il envoie les éclairs avec la pluie. \q Il fait sortir le vent des endroits où {{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} le garde.

sw.L: Kwa sauti ya kutoa [sauti] {{deity_pronoun:yake|Yake}}, [kuna] ngurumo ya maji mbinguni, \q naye hupandisha mawingu kutoka mwisho wa dunia; \q hufanya umeme kwa ajili ya mvua \q na kutoa upepo kutoka ghala {{deity_pronoun:zake|Zake}}.
sw.B: Anapopiga radi, maji yaliyo mbinguni yananguruma; \q huyainua mawingu kutoka miisho ya dunia. \q Hufanya umeme umulike pamoja na mvua \q na kuutoa upepo katika ghala {{deity_pronoun:zake|Zake}}.
sw.R: Anapopiga radi, maji yaliyo angani yananguruma. \q Huyafanya mawingu yapande kutoka mbali kwenye mwisho wa dunia. \q Hutuma umeme pamoja na mvua. \q Huutoa upepo kutoka mahali anapouhifadhi.

vi.L: Khi {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} cất [tiếng], nước trên các tầng trời gầm thét, \q Ngài khiến mây bay lên từ tận cùng đất; \q Ngài làm chớp nhoáng cho mưa \q và đem gió ra từ các kho của {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}.
vi.B: Khi {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} phát tiếng sấm, nước trên các tầng trời gầm vang; \q Ngài khiến mây bay lên từ tận cùng đất. \q Ngài làm chớp lóe lên giữa cơn mưa \q và đem gió ra từ các kho của {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}.
vi.R: Khi {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} phát tiếng sấm, nước trên bầu trời gầm vang. \q Ngài khiến mây bay lên từ những nơi xa tận cuối đất. \q Ngài sai chớp đến cùng với mưa. \q Ngài đem gió ra từ những nơi {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} cất giữ.

ko.L: 그분이 [소리를] 내시면 하늘에서 물이 요란하게 울리고, \q 그분은 땅 끝에서 구름이 올라오게 하신다. \q 그분은 비를 위하여 번개를 만드시고 \q 그분의 창고에서 바람을 내보내신다.
ko.B: 그분이 천둥소리를 내시면 하늘의 물이 요란하게 울린다. \q 그분은 땅 끝에서 구름을 일으키신다. \q 그분은 비와 함께 번개를 치게 하시고 \q 그분의 창고에서 바람을 내보내신다.
ko.R: 그분이 천둥을 치시면 하늘의 물이 요란한 소리를 낸다. \q 그분은 멀리 세상 끝에서 구름이 올라오게 하신다. \q 그분은 비와 함께 번개를 보내신다. \q 그분은 바람을 간직해 두신 곳에서 바람을 내보내신다.

pt.L: Ao som do {{deity_pronoun:seu|Seu}} dar [a voz], [há] um estrondo de águas nos céus, \q e {{deity_pronoun:ele|Ele}} faz subir as nuvens desde a extremidade da terra; \q faz relâmpagos para a chuva \q e tira o vento dos {{deity_pronoun:seus|Seus}} depósitos.
pt.B: Quando {{deity_pronoun:ele|Ele}} troveja, as águas nos céus rugem; \q {{deity_pronoun:ele|Ele}} faz subir as nuvens dos confins da terra. \q Faz o relâmpago brilhar com a chuva \q e tira o vento dos {{deity_pronoun:seus|Seus}} depósitos.
pt.R: Quando {{deity_pronoun:ele|Ele}} troveja, as águas no céu rugem. \q Ele faz as nuvens subirem lá longe, na beira do mundo. \q Ele manda relâmpagos com a chuva. \q Ele tira o vento dos lugares onde {{deity_pronoun:ele|Ele}} o guarda.

decisions.choice: at the sound of his giving: when he gives his voice, that is, thunders
decisions.reason: To "give one's voice" is a Hebrew way of saying "to speak out", and of God it means thunder (Psalm 18:14; 46:7).

decisions.choice: a roar of waters in the heavens: the rain held above the sky
decisions.reason: The heavens are pictured as holding waters above them (Genesis 1:7; Psalm 148:4), which roar down in the storm when God speaks.

decisions.choice: the same words as Psalm 135:7
decisions.reason: From "he makes clouds rise" to the end, the verse matches Psalm 135:7, and the wording of that psalm is used here. The verb forms differ slightly but the sense is the same: God, not any idol, sends the clouds, the lightning and the wind.

decisions.choice: clouds: mists that rise
decisions.reason: The word means "things lifted up" and is used of clouds or mists that rise from the horizon before rain (Psalm 135:7; Proverbs 25:14).

decisions.choice: When he thunders
decisions.reason: Balanced and Readable say what "giving his voice" means (meaning decision m1). Literal keeps the Hebrew picture and supplies the missing object.

decisions.choice: the wording of Psalm 135:7
decisions.reason: The second half of the verse is word for word Psalm 135:7, so each level keeps the published Spanish of that psalm.

decisions.choice: the wording of Psalm 135:7
decisions.reason: The last lines are the words of Psalm 135:7 (meaning decision m3); each level reuses the published Swahili of that verse.

decisions.choice: the words of Psalm 135:7 at each level
decisions.reason: From "faz subir as nuvens" to the end the verse is Psalm 135:7 (m3), and each level takes that psalm's Portuguese at the same level, as the English does.

source.text: נִבְעַ֤ר כָּל־אָדָם֙ מִדַּ֔עַת הֹבִ֥ישׁ כָּל־צוֹרֵ֖ף מִפָּ֑סֶל כִּ֛י שֶׁ֥קֶר נִסְכּ֖וֹ וְלֹא־ר֥וּחַ בָּֽם׃

records.literal_gloss: Is stupid every man without knowledge; is put to shame every smith by [the] idol, for a lie [is] his cast image, and no breath [is] in them.

en.L: Every {{gender:human|man}} is stupid, without knowledge; \q every smith is put to shame by [his] idol, \q for his cast image [is] a lie, and [there is] no breath in them.
en.B: Everyone proves senseless and ignorant; \q every goldsmith is shamed by his idol, \q for the images he casts are a fraud, with no breath in them.
en.R: Everyone who makes idols is stupid and knows nothing. \q Every goldsmith will be ashamed of the idol he made. \q His metal statues are fakes, and there is no life in them.

es.L: Todo hombre se embrutece, sin conocimiento; \q todo fundidor es avergonzado por [su] ídolo, \q porque su imagen fundida [es] mentira, y no [hay] aliento en ellas.
es.B: Todos resultan necios e ignorantes; \q todo orfebre queda en vergüenza por su ídolo, \q porque las imágenes que funde son un fraude, sin aliento en ellas.
es.R: Todo el que hace ídolos es tonto y no sabe nada. \q Todo orfebre se avergonzará del ídolo que hizo. \q Sus estatuas de metal son falsas, y no tienen vida.

fr.L: Tout {{gender:être humain|homme}} est stupide, sans connaissance ; \q tout orfèvre a honte de [son] idole, \q car son image de métal [est] mensonge, et il n’y a pas de souffle en elles.
fr.B: Tout le monde se montre stupide et ignorant ; \q tout orfèvre a honte de son idole, \q car les statues qu’il fond ne sont que tromperie, sans souffle en elles.
fr.R: Tous ceux qui fabriquent des idoles sont stupides et ne savent rien. \q Chaque orfèvre aura honte de l’idole qu’il a fabriquée. \q Ses statues de métal sont fausses, et il n’y a pas de vie en elles.

sw.L: Kila mwanadamu ni mjinga, hana maarifa; \q kila mfua chuma ameaibishwa na sanamu [yake], \q kwa maana sanamu yake ya kusubu [ni] uongo, wala hamna pumzi ndani yake.
sw.B: Kila mtu anaonekana mjinga asiye na maarifa; \q kila mfua dhahabu anaaibishwa na sanamu yake, \q kwa maana sanamu anazozisubu ni udanganyifu, hazina pumzi ndani yake.
sw.R: Kila mtu anayetengeneza sanamu ni mjinga, hajui kitu. \q Kila mfua dhahabu ataiona aibu sanamu aliyoitengeneza. \q Sanamu zake za chuma ni za uongo, wala hazina uhai ndani yake.

vi.L: Mọi người đều ngu muội, không hiểu biết; \q mọi thợ kim hoàn đều bị hổ thẹn vì tượng [mình], \q vì tượng đúc của nó [là] giả dối, và chẳng có hơi thở trong chúng.
vi.B: Mọi người đều tỏ ra ngu muội, thiếu hiểu biết; \q mọi thợ kim hoàn đều bị hổ thẹn vì thần tượng mình, \q vì tượng nó đúc ra là đồ giả, chẳng có hơi thở trong đó.
vi.R: Mọi người làm thần tượng đều ngu dại và chẳng biết gì. \q Mọi thợ kim hoàn sẽ hổ thẹn vì thần tượng mình đã làm. \q Tượng kim loại của nó là đồ giả, chẳng có sự sống trong đó.

ko.L: 모든 사람이 어리석어 지식이 없고, \q 금속 장인마다 [자기] 우상 때문에 수치를 당한다. \q 그가 부어 만든 형상은 거짓이요, 그것들 속에는 숨이 없다.
ko.B: 사람마다 어리석고 무지하다. \q 금세공인마다 자기가 만든 우상 때문에 수치를 당한다. \q 그가 부어 만든 형상은 가짜이고 그 속에는 숨이 없다.
ko.R: 우상을 만드는 사람은 모두 어리석고 아무것도 모른다. \q 금세공인마다 자기가 만든 우상 때문에 부끄러움을 당할 것이다. \q 그가 쇠붙이를 부어 만든 형상은 가짜이고, 그 속에는 생명이 없다.

pt.L: Todo {{gender:ser humano|homem}} é estúpido, sem conhecimento; \q todo fundidor é envergonhado pelo [seu] ídolo, \q pois a sua imagem fundida [é] mentira, e não [há] fôlego nelas.
pt.B: Todos se mostram insensatos e ignorantes; \q todo ourives é envergonhado pelo seu ídolo, \q pois as imagens que ele funde são uma fraude, sem fôlego nelas.
pt.R: Todos os que fazem ídolos são estúpidos e não sabem nada. \q Todo ourives vai ficar envergonhado do ídolo que fez. \q As suas estátuas de metal são falsas, e não há vida nelas.

decisions.choice: every human is stupid, without knowledge: people shown up as senseless
decisions.reason: The verb is the one used in verse 8 ("brutish"). Beside the wisdom and understanding of God who made the world (verse 12), every person who trusts in idols is shown to know nothing. The verse is about people in general, but its target is those who make and worship idols.

decisions.choice: put to shame by his idol: disgraced when it fails him
decisions.reason: The goldsmith's own work lets him down when it cannot help or answer, and he is shamed by it (Isaiah 42:17; 44:9-11).

decisions.choice: a lie: a fraud, a false thing
decisions.reason: The cast image is called "a lie" because it pretends to be a god and is not one. It is the opposite of the "true God" of verse 10.

decisions.choice: breath: the breath of life
decisions.reason: The word means breath, wind or spirit. The images have no life in them (51:17; Habakkuk 2:19; Psalm 135:17).

decisions.choice: Everyone who makes idols
alternatives: Every person is stupid and knows nothing
decisions.reason: Readable narrows "every person" to those who make idols, which is the point of the verse in its context (meaning decision m1). It is a stretch from the general words, which could also mean that every person is senseless beside God's wisdom.

decisions.choice: the images he casts ... with no breath in them (Balanced); His metal statues ... no life (Readable)
decisions.reason: The Hebrew moves from "his cast image" to "them"; Balanced and Readable use the plural throughout so the sentence reads smoothly. Readable says "life" for breath.

decisions.choice: "Todo hombre" (L); "Todos" (B); "Todo el que" (R), with no gender span
decisions.reason: Spanish "hombre" here means any human being, and "todos" covers men and women, so the English gender setting has no Spanish counterpart.

source.text: הֶ֣בֶל הֵ֔מָּה מַעֲשֵׂ֖ה תַּעְתֻּעִ֑ים בְּעֵ֥ת פְּקֻדָּתָ֖ם יֹאבֵֽדוּ׃

records.literal_gloss: Futility [are] they, a work of mockeries; at [the] time of their punishment they will perish.

en.L: They [are] futility, a work of mockery; \q at the time of their punishment they will perish.
en.B: They are empty breath, a work to be laughed at; \q when the time comes to punish them, they will perish.
en.R: Idols are worthless, something to laugh at. \q When God comes to punish them, they will be destroyed.

es.L: Vanidad [son], obra de burla; \q en el tiempo de su castigo perecerán.
es.B: Son un soplo vacío, una obra para burlarse de ella; \q cuando llegue el tiempo de castigarlos, perecerán.
es.R: Los ídolos no valen nada; son algo de lo que reírse. \q Cuando Dios venga a castigarlos, serán destruidos.

fr.L: Elles [sont] vanité, une œuvre de moquerie ; \q au temps de leur châtiment, elles périront.
fr.B: Elles ne sont que vent, une œuvre ridicule ; \q quand viendra le temps de les punir, elles périront.
fr.R: Les idoles ne valent rien, on peut seulement se moquer d’elles. \q Quand Dieu viendra les punir, elles seront détruites.

sw.L: Hizo [ni] ubatili, kazi ya mizaha; \q wakati wa kuadhibiwa kwao zitaangamia.
sw.B: Hizo ni pumzi tupu, kazi ya kuchekwa; \q wakati utakapofika wa kuziadhibu, zitaangamia.
sw.R: Sanamu hazifai kitu; ni kitu cha kuchekwa. \q Mungu atakapokuja kuziadhibu, zitaangamizwa.

vi.L: Chúng [là] hư không, là công việc đáng chế giễu; \q vào lúc chúng bị trừng phạt, chúng sẽ bị diệt.
vi.B: Chúng chỉ là hơi thở hư không, một thứ đáng chế giễu; \q khi đến lúc chúng bị trừng phạt, chúng sẽ bị tiêu diệt.
vi.R: Thần tượng thật vô giá trị, chỉ đáng để người ta chê cười. \q Khi Đức Chúa Trời đến trừng phạt chúng, chúng sẽ bị hủy diệt.

ko.L: 그것들은 헛된 것이요, 조롱거리의 작품이다. \q 그것들이 벌받는 때에 멸망할 것이다.
ko.B: 그것들은 헛된 입김이요, 비웃음거리가 될 물건이다. \q 그것들을 벌하실 때가 오면 그것들은 망할 것이다.
ko.R: 우상들은 쓸모없고 웃음거리일 뿐이다. \q 하나님께서 그것들을 벌하러 오시면 그것들은 멸망할 것이다.

pt.L: Sopro [são] eles, obra de zombaria; \q no tempo do seu castigo perecerão.
pt.B: São um sopro vazio, uma obra ridícula; \q quando chegar o tempo de castigá-los, perecerão.
pt.R: Os ídolos não valem nada, são coisas de dar risada. \q Quando Deus vier castigá-los, eles vão ser destruídos.

decisions.choice: futility: empty breath
decisions.reason: As in verse 3, but now the idols themselves are called "breath".

decisions.choice: a work of mockery: something deceptive and laughable
decisions.reason: The word appears only here and in 51:18. It comes from a root meaning to mock or to lead astray, and so can mean a work that is ridiculous or one that deceives.

decisions.choice: the time of their punishment: when God comes to deal with them
decisions.reason: The word means a visit to inspect and settle accounts. Here it is the day God calls the idols, and those who trust them, to account (8:12; 11:23).

decisions.choice: Idols ... God comes
decisions.reason: Readable names the idols and says who punishes, which the Hebrew leaves to the context.

source.text: לֹֽא־כְאֵ֜לֶּה חֵ֣לֶק יַעֲקֹ֗ב כִּֽי־יוֹצֵ֤ר הַכֹּל֙ ה֔וּא וְיִ֨שְׂרָאֵ֔ל שֵׁ֖בֶט נַֽחֲלָת֑וֹ יְהוָ֥ה צְבָא֖וֹת שְׁמֽוֹ׃ס

records.literal_gloss: Not like these [is the] portion of Jacob, for [the] former of the all he [is], and Israel [is the] tribe of his inheritance; Yahweh of hosts [is] his name.

en.L: Not like these [is] the portion of Jacob, for the one who formed all things [is] {{deity_pronoun:he|He}}, \q and Israel [is] the tribe of {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} inheritance; \q {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} of hosts [is] {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} name.
en.B: The God who is Jacob's portion is not like these, for {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} is the one who formed all things, \q and Israel is the tribe {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} holds as {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} own; \q {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} of Armies is {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} name.
en.R: But the God who belongs to Jacob's people is not like these idols, for {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} made everything there is. \q He chose Israel to be {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} very own people. \q His name is {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} of Armies.

es.L: No es como estos la porción de Jacob, porque el Formador de todo [es] {{deity_pronoun:él|Él}}, \q e Israel [es] la tribu de {{deity_pronoun:su|Su}} heredad; \q {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}} de los ejércitos [es] {{deity_pronoun:su|Su}} nombre.
es.B: El Dios que es la porción de Jacob no es como estos, porque {{deity_pronoun:él|Él}} es quien formó todas las cosas, \q e Israel es la tribu que {{deity_pronoun:él|Él}} tiene como {{deity_pronoun:suya|Suya}}; \q {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}} de los Ejércitos es {{deity_pronoun:su|Su}} nombre.
es.R: Pero el Dios del pueblo de Jacob no es como esos ídolos, porque {{deity_pronoun:él|Él}} hizo todo lo que existe. \q Él escogió a Israel para que fuera {{deity_pronoun:su|Su}} pueblo propio. \q Su nombre es {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}} de los Ejércitos.

fr.L: Celui qui est la part de Jacob n’[est] pas comme elles, car c’est {{deity_pronoun:lui|Lui}} qui a formé toutes choses, \q et Israël [est] la tribu de {{deity_pronoun:son|Son}} héritage ; \q {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} des armées [est] {{deity_pronoun:son|Son}} nom.
fr.B: Le Dieu qui est la part de Jacob n’est pas comme elles, car c’est {{deity_pronoun:lui|Lui}} qui a formé toutes choses, \q et Israël est la tribu qu’{{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} possède comme {{deity_pronoun:son|Son}} bien ; \q {{deity_pronoun:son|Son}} nom est {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} des armées.
fr.R: Mais le Dieu qui appartient au peuple de Jacob n’est pas comme ces idoles, car c’est {{deity_pronoun:lui|Lui}} qui a fait tout ce qui existe. \q Il a choisi Israël pour en faire {{deity_pronoun:son|Son}} propre peuple. \q Son nom est {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} des armées.

sw.L: Fungu la Yakobo si kama hizo, kwa maana {{deity_pronoun:yeye|Yeye}} [ndiye] aliyeviumba vitu vyote, \q na Israeli [ni] kabila la urithi {{deity_pronoun:wake|Wake}}; \q {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} wa majeshi [ndilo] jina {{deity_pronoun:lake|Lake}}.
sw.B: Mungu aliye fungu la Yakobo si kama hizo, kwa maana {{deity_pronoun:yeye|Yeye}} ndiye aliyeviumba vitu vyote, \q na Israeli ni kabila analolishika kuwa mali {{deity_pronoun:yake|Yake}}; \q {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} wa majeshi ndilo jina {{deity_pronoun:lake|Lake}}.
